SELECT d.fiscal_week, f.week_ending_date, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT (f.store_key, f.product_key)) dist_keys, count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) loads, min(f.etl_loaded_at), max(f.etl_loaded_at), sum(f.closing_value) v
FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.week_ending_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=11
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

WITH w AS (SELECT * FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date='2026-03-08'),
dups AS (SELECT store_key, product_key FROM w GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT etl_loaded_at, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT (store_key,product_key)) k, sum(closing_value) v, sum(closing_units) u,
 sum(CASE WHEN (store_key,product_key) IN (SELECT store_key,product_key FROM dups) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) in_dups
FROM w GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH a AS (SELECT store_key, product_key FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date='2026-03-01'),
b AS (SELECT store_key, product_key FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date='2026-03-15')
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM a EXCEPT SELECT * FROM b)) only_in_44,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM b EXCEPT SELECT * FROM a)) only_in_46

SELECT count(*) pairs, sum(CASE WHEN a.closing_units=b.closing_units AND a.closing_value=b.closing_value AND a.receipts_units=b.receipts_units AND a.adjustment_units=b.adjustment_units THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) identical
FROM fact_stock_week a JOIN fact_stock_week b ON a.store_key=b.store_key AND a.product_key=b.product_key AND a.week_ending_date=b.week_ending_date AND a.etl_loaded_at<b.etl_loaded_at
WHERE a.week_ending_date='2026-03-08'

b AS (SELECT store_key, product_key FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date='2026-03-15'),
x AS (SELECT * FROM a EXCEPT SELECT * FROM b)

WITH stock AS (
  -- one row per store version x product version x week (week 45 was loaded twice, identical rows)
  SELECT DISTINCT f.store_key, f.product_key, f.week_ending_date, f.closing_units, f.closing_value
  FROM fact_stock_week f
),
wk AS (
  SELECT cp.category, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week, SUM(k.closing_value) AS week_value, COUNT(*) n
  FROM stock k
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = k.week_ending_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = k.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = k.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 11
    AND s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND cs.region = 'West'
    AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT category, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, ROUND(AVG(week_value),2) avg_stock_value, count(*) weeks, min(week_value), max(week_value), sum(n)
FROM wk GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY category

WITH stock AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.store_key, f.product_key, f.week_ending_date, f.closing_units, f.closing_value
  FROM fact_stock_week f
),
wk AS (
  SELECT cp.category, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week, SUM(k.closing_value) AS week_value, COUNT(*) n
  FROM stock k
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = k.week_ending_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = k.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = k.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 11
    AND s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND cs.region = 'West'
    AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT category, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, ROUND(AVG(week_value),2) AS avg_stock_value, count(*) AS n_weeks, min(week_value) AS minv, max(week_value) AS maxv, sum(n) AS rows_used
FROM wk GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY category

SELECT count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN f.closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg_units, sum(CASE WHEN f.closing_value<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg_val,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.closing_value - f.closing_units*p.standard_unit_cost)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) value_mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.closing_units=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zero_units, max(f.closing_units) maxu, max(f.closing_value) maxv,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.week_ending_date NOT BETWEEN p.valid_from AND p.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) prod_out_of_validity,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.week_ending_date NOT BETWEEN s.valid_from AND s.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) store_out_of_validity
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT * EXCLUDE (etl_loaded_at) FROM fact_stock_week) f
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.week_ending_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=11 AND s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE region='West' AND is_current)
